messages:
erin: heads-up: ~40 snapshot uploads failed during nightly rotation, KMS reports 'grant not found' on several PUTs.
chao: saw it around 03:02 UTC. uploader logs: `AccessDeniedException: MissingGrantToken: grant not found` for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333444:key/aa11bb22
priya: pulling CloudTrail now. grant id g-7e5a4 shows created 2024-03-25 with ttl=24h. That TTL is wrong for archive uploads (should be long-lived).
erin: where did ttl=24h come from? last infra deploy changed ephemeral-grants module.
sre_lead: short term: create a replacement grant and requeue failed uploads. mid term: update infra templates to ignore grant_ttl for roles tagged `archive:true`. long term: add pre-rotation check that validates active grants for target CMKs.
chao: created temp grant and requeued: ```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id aa11bb22 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/backup-uploader --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name "manual-rotation-fix"
```
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: requeued 40 uploads; 38 completed, 2 retrying.
priya: filing SEC-2024-331 and attaching CloudTrail IDs; also adding CI linter rule that blocks `grant_ttl` in templates with `archive:true`.
security-bot: Compliance: manual grant ops must be logged and retained for 90 days. Link SEC-2024-331 to change control.
erin: propose detection rule: alert when any CMK used by a pipeline has active grants with TTL < 30d. priya: adding to backlog and will spike a parser change.
sre_lead: assign: priya -> infra PR + CI rule, chao -> audit evidence + ticket, erin -> postmortem draft. Followup 48h.
erin: thanks all. ping if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
